title: 第1346章 我请你来不是看戏的第1345章 让你们感受下什么叫做力量
content_zh:
一直到三息之后，吉恩再也无法维续这道法术，才停了手！
此时他体内的灵气，已经十不存一。
看着站在这里，一副看戏的力嗷，吉恩的气不打一处来，直接开口怼道。
“这跟我有什么关系？我的权限太低搞不定对方！你想要我控制住对方，嗯觉得我能做到吗？”
“再说了，你不是说，让我将祂驱除出去吗？问题是我现在只能跟祂耗着，根本无法直接打到他！”力嗷无辜说道。
“好！那我这就送你回去！我换一人来！我不信这么多被囚禁的罪犯，就没有一个不想要自由的！我还就不信了，没有你张屠夫，我就一定要吃那带毛的猪！”吉恩沉声说道。
吉恩也很难受，虽然他也能够理解力嗷的方法方式，就是通过耗着，量松剑耗走。
但这个过程吉恩并不知道要多久，可能是一年，也可能是一个月，问题是吉恩能承受的起，季风镇也承受不起啊！
然后他一边又想要力嗷出力，摆平松剑，那边又要小心翼翼，不能让力嗷发现，这里没有高阶修士！
要不然，让力嗷得知这方宇宙中，已知最高的修士不过是出窍期，怕是第一个想到的不是如何出力，而是想到，如何逃脱安保机器人的禁锢！
然后奴役吉恩等修士，以报这些年被宇宙联合国，囚禁在安保机器人之中的仇吧？
“呃～你这是为难我了。不过小友请放心，我搞不定那域外天魔，但那域外天魔的召唤物，我还是能搞定的！”力嗷正色说道。
力嗷一听吉恩要换人，立马想到自己这类存在，在宇宙联合国可是太多了！
所以态度那是三十六十度转变～
肉身被毁，又不想入轮回的，大有人在！
本来自己如此强大，没有肉身就没有劫难，自由自在也挺好的。
自己就是走上了“邪”路，想要一具身体，然后夺舍了一个低阶文明的成员，最后还是被宇宙联合国给逮起来了。
只是，夺舍虽然被宇宙联合国宪法禁止，但不是你夺舍了就要判死刑，它是视情节轻重给予的惩罚，也不尽相同。
自己受到的惩罚是，给宇宙联合国完成十项任务，之前自己已经完成三次了，如果这件也算，那就是第四次吧。
但现在这种情况，自己还真没有办法，人家的神念自己又打不是死，如果能够离开这牢笼，自己一个念头，对面这玩意就要灰灰把？

因为宇宙联合国，喜欢拯救快要毁灭的低阶文明，而宇宙之中的低阶文明，宛如大海的沙子，每时每刻都有文明诞生与毁灭。
这种情况下，宇宙联合国就会留下，自己这类修士，用来保护低阶文明，尽量能够渡过文明发展的“愚昧”期！
（比如野蛮战胜文明、比如所谓的弱肉强食。）
所以每一艘开拓者飞船上，都会有大量安保机器人，因为只有它们才可以承载自己这样的修士，而且还可以保护自己的神念不灭。
宇宙文明生生灭灭，宇宙联合国的开拓者飞船，就会周期性的巡视宇宙空间！
当然，大多时候文明的发展，都是有迹可循的，所以并不需要你一直盯着。
而自己不高兴，是因为此次只给自己开放了，5级力量权限！
自己可是拥有xii级权限的修士，以往几次任务，自己哪一次不是全力发挥？
content_en:
It wasn't until after three breaths that Jean could no longer maintain this spell that he stopped!
At this time, the spiritual energy in his body was gone.
Seeing him standing here, looking like he was watching a show, Gene was so angry that he directly spoke out.
"What does this have to do with me? My authority is too low to control the other party! You want me to control the other party, do you think I can do it?"
"Besides, didn't you tell me to drive him out? The problem is that I can only fight with him now, and I can't hit him directly!" Li Ao innocently said.
"Okay! Then I'll send you back right now! I'll replace you with someone else! I don't believe that there are so many imprisoned criminals who don't want to be free! I don't believe it yet. Without you Zhang Butcher, I would have to eat the pig with hair on it!" Gene said in a deep voice.
Gene also felt very uncomfortable, although he could also understand the method of Li Ao, which was to use up the sword to measure the loss.
But Gene doesn't know how long this process will take, it may be a year, or it may be a month. The problem is that if Gene can afford it, Monsoon Town can't afford it either!
Then he wanted to use Li Ao to level the Songjian, but he also had to be careful not to let Li Ao discover that there were no high-level monks here!
Otherwise, if Li Ao learns that the highest known monk in this universe is only in the out-of-body stage, his first thought is not how to contribute, but how to escape from the confinement of the security robot!
Then enslave Jean and other monks to avenge the United Nations and the United Nations who imprisoned them in security robots for these years, right?
"Uh~ You are making things difficult for me. But don't worry, little friend, I can't handle the extraterrestrial demon, but I can still handle the summons of the extraterrestrial demon!" Li Ao said sternly.
When Li Ao heard that Jean was going to replace someone, he immediately thought that there were too many existences like him in the Universal United Nations!
So that’s a thirty-sixty-degree change in attitude~
There are many people who have had their physical bodies destroyed but do not want to enter reincarnation!
Originally, I was so powerful, and without a physical body, there would be no disasters, and it would be nice to be free.
He just embarked on the "evil" path, wanted a body, and then killed a member of a low-level civilization. In the end, he was arrested by the United Nations of the Universe.
However, although seizing a body is prohibited by the Constitution of the United Nations, it does not mean that you will be sentenced to death if you seize a body. It is a punishment that depends on the severity of the case and is not the same.
The punishment he received was to complete ten tasks for the United Nations. He had already completed it three times before. If this one counts, it would be the fourth time.
But in this situation, I really have no choice. I can't kill the person's spiritual thoughts. If I can leave this cage, I have a thought, and the thing on the other side will be reduced to ashes?
Because the Universal United Nations likes to save low-level civilizations that are about to be destroyed, and low-level civilizations in the universe are like the sand of the sea, with civilizations being born and destroyed every moment.
In this case, the Universal United Nations will leave behind monks like themselves to protect low-level civilizations and try their best to survive the "ignorance" period of civilization development!
(For example, barbarism defeats civilization, such as the so-called law of the jungle.)
Therefore, there will be a large number of security robots on every pioneer spaceship, because only they can carry monks like themselves, and they can also protect their spiritual thoughts.
As civilizations in the universe come and go, the pioneer spacecraft of the United Nations will periodically patrol the universe!
Of course, most of the time, the development of civilization can be traced, so you don't need to keep an eye on it.
And I'm not happy because this time the level 5 power authority is only opened to me!
I am a monk with xii-level authority. In the past few missions, which one did I not give my best?
